instruction: Open your browsing history in Chrome.

metadata.trajectory_summary: Agent successfully navigated to Chrome password manager via 3-dot menu > Passwords and autofill > Google Password Manager in 4 turns.
metadata.capability_extraction: Can open Chrome 3-dot menu, navigate submenus, access internal chrome:// pages, interact with Chrome settings UI.
metadata.task_rationale: Tests same Chrome internal page navigation ability but targeting history page instead of password manager.
metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to chrome://history. Evaluator uses is_expected_active_tab_approximate to check the active tab URL matches chrome://history.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter active_url_from_accessTree correctly extracts active tab URL from accessibility tree with empty goto_prefix, which is correct for chrome:// scheme URLs.

Metric is_expected_active_tab_approximate correctly receives the rules dict directly (type=url, url=chrome://history) and compares URLs after stripping query parameters. Parameter handling is correct per framework behavior.
Instruction coverage is complete: the single requirement (open browsing history) is verified by checking the active tab URL matches chrome://history.

Minor concern: URL comparison uses urlparse which distinguishes between 'chrome://history' and 'chrome://history/' (trailing slash). If Chrome's address bar displays the URL with a trailing slash, this could cause a false negative.
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider normalizing trailing slashes in URL comparison to handle cases where Chrome may display 'chrome://history/' instead of 'chrome://history'.
